push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Creamsters | You: 10.0 (best match performance)
push.body:
Ring the dinner bell, PhogsToffees. A 10.0 and your best match performance.

THE GOOD
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 7.6. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 93% passing on 29 attempts, up from your usual 72%. You kept us calm by keeping the ball.
+ 5 shots at FC Creamsters's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ Man of the Match. Put that one on the fridge.

THE BAD
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Quick fix: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Biscuits if you nail it.
- 3rd straight match under 25% tackle success. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Passes attempted 29, from 41 in your previous match. One honest look at that and we move forward.

Teach your feet: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: A team that laughs together stays together. Tell a bad joke tomorrow.

You're making believers out of everybody. - Coach Lasso

If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

Your best match performance, BellyTb1. A 9.3 against FC Creamsters. That's the good stuff, bottled and labeled.

THE GOOD
+ 34 passes, your busiest match yet. You found pockets of space like a cat finds sunbeams.
+ A brace against FC Creamsters, your 4th straight match scoring. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.
+ 1 key pass. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ 9.3: a career best over 4 games.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and PhogsToffees.

THE BAD
- Misplaced passes 12, up from your usual 6. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Bread and butter: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- 3 shots off target: -0.1. Let's not make it a habit.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Tidy that up.

Repetition station: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

Hey BellyTb1, hold onto this one: You can't rush a good brisket or a good player.

That's how it's done. More of that, please. - Coach Lasso
